_about: Camera signature and per view exposure for the King Studio photoreal loop. EXIF values are from the Galaxy S25 Ultra ultrawide originals (13 mm equivalent, f/1.9, auto white balance, 2026-08-12 about 14:10 CDT). ev100 = log2(F^2 / T) - log2(ISO / 100). Post pass parameters are deliberately small: an over graded frame is its own tell. grainStd is the luminance noise (std of a 64x64 flat wall patch minus its own 9 px blur) measured in the matching photograph at 2000 px width; measured 0.0039 at 2000 px and 0.0038 at 1200 px on the bed photograph's ceiling, so it is not scaled with width (grainWidthExponent 0); it is scaled with the square root of each view's ISO relative to isoRef.
